investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stratus Ride (ride-hailing); Platform: AWS ap-southeast-1; Kubernetes cluster sr-prod-apse1 (EKS, 14 general-purpose worker nodes, node range 10.90.0.0/16); Automation: an in-house node-recycler controller rotates worker nodes older than 14 days (cordon, drain, terminate, replace) in batches bounded by its maxUnavailable setting (15%); controller runs are recorded with RECYCLE- identifiers; Deployments: Argo CD (CHG- identifiers).
